Join a guided walk up Tenranzan to discover nature's subtle changes that you might miss on an ordinary walk.

【Fee】
¥2,000 per person, ¥1,500 for repeat visitors, ¥4,000 per family (includes guide fee, insurance, etc.)

【Capacity】
10 people

【Guide】
Tsubasa Kojima (Wildlife Division)

【What to bring】
Drink, rain gear, backpack (something with free hands recommended), towel, insect repellent
